notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Day-one patch additions and fixes: 

Additions: 

-Added 10 more levels, totalling 30 levels. 
-Added a shop which allows players to purchase extra lives at 15 coins per life. 
-Introduced moving platforms. 
-Introduced a new evil shape! 

Improvements: 
- Press space to restart the level when dead. 

Fixes: 
- Some reports of lives resetting to 1 when transitioning levels, this should be fixed. 
- Some reports of level select not displaying the levels the player has unlocked, this should be fixed.
